summary: Marpai, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into securities purchase agreements for a private placement of 12,100 shares of newly designated Series A Preferred Stock at $1,000 per share, raising approximately $12.1 million. Each share is convertible into common stock at $1.00 per share, with an 8% dividend payable in common stock upon conversion or liquidity event. The preferred stock votes with common stock on an as-converted basis and has a beneficial ownership limitation. The initial closing occurred around July 31, 2026. This is a capital raise through preferred equity, which may be classified as a capital return event. What to watch: conversion overhang and potential dilution to common shareholders.
